# `catchAllTagDispatchToCatchTag`

Suggests Effect.catchTag or Effect.catchTags for catch-all handlers that re-fail unmatched tagged errors

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377122` |
| Language Service name | `catchAllTagDispatchToCatchTag` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/catch-all-tag-dispatch-to-catch-tag` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
class Timeout extends Data.TaggedError("Timeout")<{}> {}
class Unauthorized extends Data.TaggedError("Unauthorized")<{}> {}

declare const program: Effect.Effect<string, NotFound | Timeout | Unauthorized>

export const recovered = program.pipe(
  Effect.catch((error) => {
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(catch-all-tag-dispatch-to-catch-tag): Branching on `error._tag` inside `Effect.catch` hand-rolls tagged error dispatch; use `Effect.catchTag` or `Effect.catchTags`, which re-fail unmatched errors automatically.
*/
    switch (error._tag) {
      case "NotFound":
        return Effect.succeed("guest")
      case "Timeout":
        return Effect.succeed("retrying")
      default:
        return Effect.fail(error)
    }
  })
)
```
